module.en: GuiMixin that lets a GuiElement ask for UI sound samples through a replaceable callback; muting is possible per element. Sample names are expected to come from `GuiSoundPlayer.SOUND_SAMPLES` (defined elsewhere, UNVERIFIED). Client-side only.
module.fr: Mixin GuiMixin permettant à un GuiElement de demander des sons d'interface via un callback remplaçable ; la coupure est possible par élément. Les noms d'échantillons doivent venir de `GuiSoundPlayer.SOUND_SAMPLES` (défini ailleurs, NON VÉRIFIÉ). Côté client uniquement.

PlaySampleMixin.new.en: Creates the mixin instance through `GuiMixin.new` with its own metatable.
PlaySampleMixin.new.fr: Crée l'instance du mixin via `GuiMixin.new` avec sa propre métatable.

PlaySampleMixin:addTo.en: Attaches the mixin to a GuiElement and adds `setPlaySampleCallback`, `playSample` and `disablePlaySample`; the callback starts as the empty `NO_CALLBACK`. Returns whether it was added.
PlaySampleMixin:addTo.fr: Attache le mixin à un GuiElement et ajoute `setPlaySampleCallback`, `playSample` et `disablePlaySample` ; le callback démarre sur `NO_CALLBACK`, vide. Renvoie si l'ajout a eu lieu.

PlaySampleMixin.setPlaySampleCallback.en: Sets the function called with a sample name whenever the element wants to play a UI sound.
PlaySampleMixin.setPlaySampleCallback.fr: Définit la fonction appelée avec un nom d'échantillon chaque fois que l'élément veut jouer un son d'interface.

PlaySampleMixin.playSample.en: Calls the play callback with the sample name unless the element's `soundDisabled` field is truthy.
PlaySampleMixin.playSample.fr: Appelle le callback de lecture avec le nom de l'échantillon sauf si le champ `soundDisabled` de l'élément est vrai.

PlaySampleMixin.disablePlaySample.en: Replaces the callback with `NO_CALLBACK`; a later `setPlaySampleCallback` can set a new one again.
PlaySampleMixin.disablePlaySample.fr: Remplace le callback par `NO_CALLBACK` ; un `setPlaySampleCallback` ultérieur peut en définir un nouveau.

PlaySampleMixin:clone.en: Copies the play callback from a source element to its clone.
PlaySampleMixin:clone.fr: Copie le callback de lecture d'un élément source vers son clone.
